pair.value: PE Import CSV and Update Tables
Import the CSV file from SFTP location and store the data in table
="PE Import CSV and Update Tables "& pv!fileName

annotation.text: Use of process variables: csvFile: This PV hold the value of CSV file which get imported in a table. fileName; This PV hold the value of File name which has been processed. importErrorMessage: This PV holds the value of error message if we get any error in importing CSV to database. isImportSuccess: This PV holds the value of if our import get succeed or not. isTruncateSuccess: This PV holds the value of if our truncation got succeed or not. tempTable: This PV holds the value of table name. truncateErrorMessage: This PV holds the value of truncate error message when our truncation got any error. truncateStoredProcedureName: This PV Holds the value of Store procedure which need to be truncate.
Process will get terminate after 20 minute if process get struck somewhere
